name: Kana
source:
She seems sensitive, sweet and curious. She's the most interested in learning about Psychology and is passionate about being kind to those who've suffered.

Kana didn't have many friends at her previous school and had been expelled from the school prior to Minami.

[From Beyond You Wiki]
